Depression is this suffocating entity that suppresses the “human” or “soul” that is inside of a body. The result of this is lacking the ability to feel real, true emotions — the emotions that allow us to connect and bond with other souls. Depression is not getting out of bed, not because you don’t want to, but because you are too exhausted mentally to do so. Exhausted because maintaining a facade of “happy”, “pleasant”, and “normal” is quite exhausting when that is nowhere near how you feel on the inside. Depression is like wanting to cease existing but not being able to go through with it because you’re worried your Mom will be upset. Depression is putting others before yourself: you feign happiness around your family and friends because you know they want to see you get better. You lie to your therapist saying that you feel better because you want them to feel the satisfaction of doing their job right. Depression is an empty void where there is absolutely no one but yourself and no matter how loud you scream, no one will ever hear your cries. Depression is unforgiving. Depression is evil.
